svg.title: The area under f prime is the net change in f
svg.desc: Top: the graph of f prime of x = 1 - x/4 on [0, 6]. The triangle above the x-axis from 0 to 4 has area 2; the triangle below from 4 to 6 has area 0.5. Bottom: the graph of f(x) = 1 + x - x squared over 8, from (0, 1), rising to a maximum at x = 4 and falling to (6, 2.5). A bracket shows f(6) - f(0) = 2 - 0.5 = 1.5, the net area under f prime.

text.tspan: f rises while f′ > 0, then falls
The area under the rate f′ from 0 to 6 is the net change in f over [0, 6].
